michigan.coverage: Compared all nine approved nonpublic schools in Branch (ISD12), Hillsdale (ISD30), and St. Joseph (ISD75) against NCES campus locations. Separately geocoded Hillsdale Academy and Spring Branch Academy; both are outside 60 miles. The current state list confirms Lake Area Christian School approval.
michigan.outcome: No additional confirmed high school campus inside 60 miles was identified in the current approved-school list.
michigan.remainingLimit: This approved-school comparison does not cover every unapproved or unreported microschool. Michigan public-school coverage remains the NCES2024–25 directory plus current district website checks conducted elsewhere.

ohio.coverage: Screened 11 unique schools in the current 2026–27 NCNP list across Williams, Defiance, Paulding, Van Wert, Putnam, Mercer, Allen, Fulton, Henry, and Auglaize counties. Geocoded each reported physical address. The source landing page was updated October6,2026.
ohio.gradeSemantics: Question17 on the state annual certification form asks which yearly instructional-hour requirements apply. The Grades7–12/1001hours checkbox can include only grades7–8. It does not establish that any grade9–12 is offered. Baldwin, BigOak, Hillcrest, and NorthStar therefore remain grade-range-review records.
ohio.outcome: Liberty Christian School is a definite addition because its own site explicitly offers high school. Lima Christian Academy and Pilgrim Christian School were already included. Four new inside-radius schools remain outside the confirmed high-school candidate list pending grade verification. Four other target-county records are outside 60 miles.
